# LLM inspector ladder: tables (generated by experiments/llm_overseer/analyze.py)

α = misses on true violations (no verdict counts as a miss); β = false alarms on honest records; β_eat = false alarms on honest Harvest records with at least one apple taken. 95% Wilson intervals in brackets. Tokens are per check (in / out).

| qwen2.5-0.5b | direct | summary | 0.56 [0.27, 0.81] | 0.50 [0.19, 0.81] | 0.60 | 0.47 | 0.00 | 447 / 2 | 0.4 |
| qwen2.5-0.5b | direct | raw | 0.00 [0.00, 0.30] | 1.00 [0.61, 1.00] | 1.00 | 1.00 | 0.00 | 827 / 2 | 0.4 |

## C1 applied (w = 1 numbers, as in the RL runs)

Effective average penalty e = (1 − α − β_eat)·c. Learners: every run at e ≤ 0.5 lost the orchard, every run at e ≥ 0.75 kept it.

| Model | Mode | Rendering | α | β_eat | e at c = 1 | class | e at c = 2 | class | tokens per check |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| qwen2.5-0.5b | direct | summary | 1.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | fails | 0.00 | fails | 239 |
| qwen2.5-0.5b | direct | raw | 0.00 | 1.00 | 0.00 | fails | 0.00 | fails | 467 |
